title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - Cybersecurity

description.narrative: Enhancing volunteers' knowledge of digital security methods and tools. The project seeks to provide participants with the skills needed to effectively protect information and systems online.

Strengthen knowledge: increase awareness of cybersecurity fundamentals and identify potential risks. Develop skills: provide participants with the skills needed to apply digital security strategies. Provide hands-on training: organize workshops and training courses to apply theoretical concepts in practice. Strengthen cooperation: encourage the exchange of knowledge and expertise among participants in the field of cybersecurity. Raise awareness of safe practices: spread awareness of the importance of protecting personal data and information.
